caseName: United Air Lines, Inc. v. Porterfield
caseNameFull: United Air Lines, Inc. v. Porterfield, Tax Commissioner of Ohio
judges: Appeal, Consideration, Douglas, Noted, Should, Took

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. Ohio dismissed for want of substantial federal question.

Mr. Justice Douglas is of the opinion that probable jurisdiction should be noted. Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this appeal.
